Round two of spooky season just landed. 🎃🎤 Drag-O-Ween Karaoke is back and taking over the Main Floor — costumes on, mic in hand, Beah Hazard hyping every note like it's the main event. Best costume walks away with two tickets to an upcoming show, so come dressed to kill. Fog, face paint, and a crowd that's half in drag, half in horror — this is the Wednesday you build your whole week around. Free entry, zero excuses. 🕸️👻

Fog curling across the floor. Face paint glowing under the lights. A mic that's already seen some things. 🖤🎃 Drag-O-Ween Karaoke turns the Main Floor into a Halloween fever dream — Beah Hazard keeps the energy humming while costumed queens and freaks trade the spotlight one chorus at a time. Every scream-along anthem hits harder when half the crowd's in full drag. The smoke thickens, the night gets weirder, and you feel every beat of it. This isn't just karaoke — it's a vibe you walk into. 🕸️🎤

Come as you are — or come as something way scarier. 🎃🖤 Drag-O-Ween Karaoke is for the costumed, the curious, the ones who've never touched a mic and the ones who live for it. Beah Hazard hosts a Main Floor full of Latinx energy, face paint, and fearless sing-alongs where nobody's judging your pitch or your getup. Best costume wins two tickets to an upcoming show, but honestly the real prize is the room itself — loud, weird, welcoming, yours. Bring your people, bring your worst/best costume, and take the mic. 🎤👻
